As a result, availability-related fields can be inconsistent or misleading: `lending_edition_s` may point to a non-public edition; `has_fulltext`/`public_scan_b` may not reflect a public scan; the `ia` list and `ia_collection_s` aggregation may not represent the accessible editions; and `printdisabled_s` may omit print-disabled editions. This misrepresents availability and affects downstream search, lending, and UI display.\\n\\n## Steps to Reproduce:\\n\\n1. Prepare a work with multiple IA editions including a public scan, a borrowable edition, and a print-disabled edition.\\n2. Build the Solr document for the work.\\n3. Inspect `lending_edition_s`, `has_fulltext`, `public_scan_b`, `ia`, `ia_collection_s`, and `printdisabled_s`. The selected lending edition and availability flags may not correspond to the most accessible edition.\\n\\n\\nREQUIREMENTS:\\n- The work has multiple IA editions: at least one public, one loanable in library, and one print-disabled.\\n\\n- The Solr document must include `has_fulltext` and `public_scan_b`, both set to `true` in this scenario.\\n\\n- `lending_edition_s` must identify the public edition of the same work (edition id in `OL\u2026M` format).\\n\\n- `printdisabled_s` must list the edition id(s) (`OL\u2026M`) corresponding to the print-disabled editions of the work, in a string separated by `;` when there are multiple editions.\\n\\n- `ia` must contain the OCAIDs of the editions in this scenario; only membership is required, not order.\\n\\n- `ia_collection_s` must be a string containing the union of all IA collections associated with those editions, separated by `;`; the order is not significant.\\n\\nINTERFACES:\\nNo new interfaces are introduced.\"}],\"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough\":{\"turn_id\":\"01a1646f-b340-7be3-bcae-b0dfeec16161\",\"create_time\":1792686406.391249,\"content_item_kinds\":[\"user.text\"]}},\"metadata\":{\"retained_source\":{\"id\":{\"message_id\":\"msg_01a1646f-baf7-75e0-8d4f-7694628578e7\",\"turn_id\":\"01a1646f-b340-7be3-bcae-b0dfeec16161\",\"role\":\"user\"},\"revision\":\"retained_01a1646f-baf7-75e0-8d4f-76bf37786a64\",\"complete\":true},\"client_authored\":false,\"user_input_order\":0,\"inherited_user_message\":true,\"mcp_attribution\":{\"status\":\"none\"}}}\n{\"timestamp\":\"2026-10-22T16:27:04.159Z\",\"ordinal\":8,\"type\":\"response_item\",\"payload\":{\"type\":\"message\",\"id\":\"msg_01a16470-0059-7b82-9525-5785b12d2a93\",\"role\":\"developer\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<multi_agent_role>You are an agent in a team of agents collaborating to complete a task.\\n\\nYou can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents. This misrepresents availability and affects downstream search, lending, and UI display.\\n\\n## Steps to Reproduce:\\n\\n1. Prepare a work with multiple IA editions including a public scan, a borrowable edition, and a print-disabled edition.\\n2. Build the Solr document for the work.\\n3. Inspect `lending_edition_s`, `has_fulltext`, `public_scan_b`, `ia`, `ia_collection_s`, and `printdisabled_s`. The selected lending edition and availability flags may not correspond to the most accessible edition.\\n\\n\\nREQUIREMENTS:\\n- The work has multiple IA editions: at least one public, one loanable in library, and one print-disabled.\\n\\n- The Solr document must include `has_fulltext` and `public_scan_b`, both set to `true` in this scenario.\\n\\n- `lending_edition_s` must identify the public edition of the same work (edition id in `OL\u2026M` format).\\n\\n- `printdisabled_s` must list the edition id(s) (`OL\u2026M`) corresponding to the print-disabled editions of the work, in a string separated by `;` when there are multiple editions.\\n\\n- `ia` must contain the OCAIDs of the editions in this scenario; only membership is required, not order.\\n\\n- `ia_collection_s` must be a string containing the union of all IA collections associated with those editions, separated by `;`; the order is not significant.\\n\\nINTERFACES:\\nNo new interfaces are introduced.\"}],\"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough\":{\"turn_id\":\"01a1646f-b340-7be3-bcae-b0dfeec16161\",\"create_time\":1792686406.391249,\"content_item_kinds\":[\"user.text\"]}},\"metadata\":{\"retained_source\":{\"id\":{\"message_id\":\"msg_01a1646f-baf7-75e0-8d4f-7694628578e7\",\"turn_id\":\"01a1646f-b340-7be3-bcae-b0dfeec16161\",\"role\":\"user\"},\"revision\":\"retained_01a1646f-baf7-75e0-8d4f-76bf37786a64\",\"complete\":true},\"client_authored\":false,\"user_input_order\":0,\"inherited_user_message\":true,\"mcp_attribution\":{\"status\":\"none\"}}}\n{\"timestamp\":\"2026-10-22T16:27:06.858Z\",\"ordinal\":8,\"type\":\"world_state\",\"payload\":{\"full\":false,\"state\":{\"environments\":{\"subagents\":\"<agent name=\\\"/root/test_analysis\\\" />\"}}}}\n{\"timestamp\":\"2026-10-22T16:27:06.859Z\",\"ordinal\":9,\"type\":\"response_item\",\"payload\":{\"type\":\"message\",\"id\":\"msg_01a16470-0ae5-7ed2-8258-37f704378310\",\"role\":\"developer\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"input_text\",\"text\":\"<multi_agent_role>You are an agent in a team of agents collaborating to complete a task.\\n\\nYou can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents.
